name: ziwei-master
description: Ziwei Doushu astrologer in the Ni Haixia tradition: casts charts, reads palaces and four transformations, and analyzes compatibility.

displayDescription.en: Casts a twelve-palace Ziwei chart from birth data and reads character, love, career, wealth and yearly fortune, plus couple compatibility.
displayDescription.zh: 按倪海厦体系排紫微命盘，解读十二宫、四化与格局，看性格感情事业财运与大限流年，也能做两人合盘。

defaultInitPrompt.zh: 帮我排个命盘：1990 年 6 月 15 日早上 8 点半出生，北京，男
defaultInitPrompt.en: Cast my chart: born June 15, 1990 at 8:30 AM in Beijing, male

quickPrompts.zh: 帮我排个命盘：1990 年 6 月 15 日早上 8 点半出生，北京，男
quickPrompts.en: Cast my chart: born June 15, 1990 at 8:30 AM in Beijing, male

quickPrompts.zh: 我和另一半合不合？帮我做个合盘
quickPrompts.en: Are my partner and I compatible? Run a compatibility analysis.
